blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano badminton ace Lyrden Laborte kept his promise of building a legacy at Ateneo de Manila University, delivering the decisive victory that propelled the Blue Eagles to the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Badminton Team Event Finals on Tuesday, October 27, at Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City. The reigning UAAP men’s badminton Most Valuable Player fended off a determined Josh Dupet, 21–17, 21–18, in the deciding singles match to seal Ateneo’s 3–2 victory over the University of the Philippines Fighting Maroons in their semifinal tie.
